ApprovalDecision.description: Yes or no to a tool call.

oneOf.description: Run it.
Run it, and the same command or file again this session.
Don't run it.
Don't run it, and tell the model why.

ApprovalPolicy.description:
Who answers a session's approvals, questions and loop-cap decisions.
Codex's `approvalPolicy` names the same choice.

oneOf.description: The client answers each request.

Nobody is there to ask, as in `koda exec`: Koda approves what the
mode allows, refuses destructive actions and anything outside the
sandbox, answers a question with nothing and goes on at the loop
cap. Each request is still sent, followed at once by
`serverRequest/resolved`, so a reader sees what was decided.

ClientInfo.description: A client's name and version, such as `koda-cli` `0.7.0`.

oneOf.description: Summarizing.
History was replaced.
A precondition stopped it; nothing changed.
The summary call failed; nothing changed.
Context passed the auto-compact threshold before a model call.
The provider rejected a request as too long.
The estimate was past the window, so history was dropped unsummarized.
A session idle long enough had its old tool results cleared.
The client asked for it with `session/compact/start`.

The turn's final reply left the context past the after-turn
threshold; it ran before `turn/completed`.

ConfigBatchWriteParams.description: `config/batchWrite`: change several keys at once, as Codex's does.

edits.description: The changes, applied in order; all or none.

ConfigEdit.description: One change: a key, its new value (`null` removes it) and how to merge.

mergeStrategy.description: How the value merges; for Koda's keys, both replace it.

value.description:
The value: a string, or for `mcp_servers.<name>` a server
([`crate::mcp::McpServerConfigValue`]); `null` removes the key.

ConfigReadResponse.description:
The answer to `config/read`: the saved settings. A key nothing has
saved is absent, and a new session then uses the host's own.

retry.description: The retry, when there is one.

turnId.description: The turn, when it happened in one.

willRetry.description: Whether Koda will try again. The turn goes on if so.

ErrorObject.description: What went wrong with a request.

code.description: One of the codes in [`codes`], or a Koda code.

data.description: Detail for a program, if any.

ErrorResponse.description: The answer to a request that failed.

id.description: The request's id; `null` when it couldn't be read.

ExecSummary.description: `exec/summary`: the run as a whole. Only `koda exec` sends it, last.

success.description: Whether the run succeeded. An interrupted turn is not a failure.

toolCalls.description: The agent's own tool calls, by tool.

turnStatus.description: How the turn ended; `None` if it never did.

usage.description:
Everything stored for the session, sub-agents and the earlier turns
of a resumed session included.

usageByAgent.description: `usage` by agent. The session's own calls are under `main`.

ImageInput.description: An image sent with a turn's input.

InitializeParams.description: The client says who it is.

InitializeResponse.description: The server says what it is and which protocol it speaks.

oneOf.description:
What the user said: a turn's prompt, or steering text added while it
ran, as the model received it. Steering texts that reached the model
together are one item.

clientMessageIds.description: The client's ids for the messages it carries, where it gave them.

oneOf.description: Text from the model. Complete text on `item/completed`.

text.description: The text so far: empty when it starts.

oneOf.description: The model's reasoning, where the provider shows it.

text.description: The text so far: empty when it starts.

oneOf.description: A tool call.

detail.description:
What the call would do, in a line, when Koda asked about it or
blocked it.

id.description: The call's id, from the model.

output.description:
What the model reads: the tool's output, or why it didn't run.
Set on completion.

oneOf.description: Context compaction: old history summarized or dropped to make room.

contextPercent.description: Context used when it began, in percent, where it was measured.

messagesRemoved.description: Rows taken out of the context, when completed.

reason.description: Why it was skipped or failed.

summaryTokens.description: Estimated size of the summary, when there is one.

parentItemId.description: On a sub-agent's items: the tool call that started the sub-agent.
On a sub-agent's items: the tool call that started the sub-agent.

mcp_servers.description: The MCP servers every new session starts, by name.

model.description:
The model a new session starts with: an alias such as `claude-opus`,
which follows its line, or an id.

sessionId.description:
The session whose servers to list. Without one, the stored servers,
none of them started.

LoopCapDecision.description: Whether a turn at its cap goes on.

oneOf.description: 50 more iterations.
200 more iterations.
Stop the turn.

LoopCapParams.description:
`turn/loopCap/requestDecision`: the turn reached its iteration cap.
Until it is answered the turn waits.

oneOf.description: Told the model to change course; the turn goes on.
The model didn't, so the turn stops.

McpServerConfigValue.description:
One MCP server's config, in Codex's `[mcp_servers.<name>]` shape: a
`command` for a server Koda starts, or a `url` for one it reaches over
streamable HTTP.

bearer_token_env_var.description:
The environment variable that holds the bearer token. The token
itself is never stored.

command.description: The command that starts the server.

http_headers.description: Headers sent with every HTTP request.

required.description:
A session doesn't start without it: `session/start` fails when it
fails to start.

startup_timeout_sec.description: Seconds the server has to start (default 30).

url.description: The server's URL, for streamable HTTP.

McpServerConnectionStatus.description: Where a server's connection stands; Codex's values that Koda produces.

oneOf.description: Not started: stored, but no session has it.
Starting.
Connected; its tools are offered.
It failed to start.

McpServerRefreshParams.description:
`config/mcpServer/reload`: every open session takes the stored servers
again, starting new ones, stopping removed ones and restarting changed
or failed ones, before its next turn.

oneOf.description: Starting.
Started; its tools are offered.
It failed to start.
Stopped before it had started.

McpServerStatus.description: One server as a session has it.

toolsError.description: Why it has no tools, when it failed.

McpServerStatusUpdatedNotification.description:
`mcpServer/startupStatus/updated`: a session's server started, failed
or was stopped while starting.

description.description: What it does, as the server says.

MergeStrategy.description: How an edit's value merges with what's there.

oneOf.description: Replace the value.
Merge into it; for a string, the same as replace.

anyOf.description: A call that expects a response.

Message.description:
Any message on the wire, in either direction.

The variants are told apart by their members, as the specification
does: a request has `id` and `method`, a notification `method` only, a
response `result`, an error `error`.

alias.description:
The alias this entry is, such as `claude-opus`, which follows its
line. A pick by alias should be made by it.

id.description:
The id to send, or `auto-detect` for `local`, whose model the server
names.

baseUrl.description: The provider's endpoint. Without one, its default.

modelProvider.description: The provider, by id. Without one, the host's.

data.description:
The models, aliases first. For Anthropic, the newest model of each
line, not every model it lists.

ModelProviderApiKeyRemoveParams.description:
`modelProvider/apiKey/remove`: forget a provider's stored key. One set
in the environment Koda was started with stays.

ModelProviderApiKeySetParams.description:
`modelProvider/apiKey/set`: store a provider's API key. Koda keeps a key
per provider, which Codex, whose `account/login/start` signs in one
OpenAI account, doesn't. The key never comes back in any response.

data.description: The providers, in the order a picker shows them.

defaultProviderId.description: The host's provider, which a new session uses by default.

ModelProviderSummary.description: One provider. Codex's `ModelProviderSummary`, with Koda's key status.

hasApiKey.description: Whether a key is set for it. Never the key itself.

name.description: The name a person reads, such as `LM Studio`.

requiresApiKey.description: Whether it needs an API key.

Notification.description: A one-way message: nothing answers it.

oneOf.description: Standard output.
Standard error.

PlanStepStatus.description: How far a plan step got.

oneOf.description: Not started.
Being worked on.
Done.

Request.description: A call that expects a [`Response`] or an [`ErrorResponse`] with the same id.

anyOf.description: A numeric id. Koda's own clients use these.

RequestId.description: A request id, chosen by whoever sends the request.

Response.description: The result of a request that succeeded.

Retry.description: A model call that will be tried again.

attempt.description: The attempt that failed, counting from 1.

delayMs.description: The wait before the next one.

maxAttempts.description: The attempts the call gets in all.

RetryReason.description: Why a model call is tried again.

oneOf.description: The provider said to slow down.
A connection failed or timed out.
The provider answered with a server error.
The reply's stream failed partway; what it had shown is discarded.
The context was too long; it was compacted first.
The model returned nothing.

available.description: Whether it works on this machine. Auto mode needs it.

ServerRequestResolvedNotification.description:
`serverRequest/resolved`: a request needs no answer any more. Other
clients dismiss their prompt. In `koda exec`, Koda answers its own
requests and sends this right after each.

Session.description:
A session: one stored conversation. Codex's `Thread`. What it's running
with (`model` through `tools`) is there only while it is open, as from
`session/start`; `session/list` gives stored sessions without it.

createdAt.description: When it was created, in Unix seconds.

cwd.description: The project it works in; absent for sessions too old to record it.

id.description: The session's id, for resuming it.

mode.description: What Koda may do without asking.

name.description: Its title, set from the first prompt.

preview.description: The first user message; empty before there is one.

tools.description: The tools the model is offered.

updatedAt.description: When its last message was stored, in Unix seconds.

SessionCompactStartParams.description:
`session/compact/start`: compact an open session's history now, as
Codex's `thread/compact/start`. Answered at once; the compaction runs as
a turn of its own (`turn/started`, a `contextCompaction` item with the
`manual` trigger, `turn/completed`). A running turn is stopped first and
ends interrupted. The compaction's turn can be interrupted, not steered.

SessionDeleteParams.description:
`session/delete`: delete a stored session. An open one is closed first,
its running turn stopped, as Codex's `thread/delete` does.

sessionId.description: The session, by its full id.

cwd.description: The project whose sessions to list; without one, the host's.

limit.description: How many at most; without one, 50.

data.description: The sessions, without what open ones are running with.

SessionSettings.description: What a session's turns run with.

alias.description: The alias the model was chosen by, if any.

effort.description: The reasoning effort sent, if any.

SessionSettingsUpdateParams.description:
`session/settings/update`: what the session's next turns run with, as
Codex's `thread/settings/update`. Only what's given changes. A running
turn keeps its own; `session/settings/updated` follows once applied.
The provider can't change: a model of another provider is refused.

model.description: The model: an id, or an alias of the session's provider.

settings.description: All of its settings, as they are now.

approvalPolicy.description: Who answers the session's requests. Without one, the client does.

baseUrl.description:
The provider's endpoint, for a local server or a gateway. Without
one, the provider's default, or a resumed session's own.

model.description:
The model: an id, or an alias such as `claude-opus`, which follows
its line's newest model. Without one, the provider's default, or a
resumed session's own choice, an alias resolved again.

modelProvider.description:
The provider, by id (`anthropic`, `lm-studio`, …, as
`modelProvider/list` gives them). A new session without one uses the
host's; a resumed one keeps the provider it was started with, as
Codex's `thread/resume` does. A session's provider never changes.

sessionId.description:
An earlier session to resume, by its full id. Without one, a new
session starts.

session.description: The session, ready for a turn.

SessionStartedNotification.description: `session/started`: a session is ready for its first turn.

protocolVersion.description: [`crate::PROTOCOL_VERSION`]. A reader that can't read it should stop.

SessionUnsubscribeParams.description:
`session/unsubscribe`: the client is done with a session. Its running
turn, if any, stops, and the session is closed; `session/start` with its
id opens it again. Codex's `thread/unsubscribe`.

SessionUnsubscribeStatus.description:
What `session/unsubscribe` did. Codex also has `notSubscribed`, for a
session other clients still hold; a Koda host has one client.

oneOf.description: The session was open, and now isn't.
No session with that id was open.

StateReadResponse.description:
The model, provider, context window, mode and sandbox a new session
starts with.

mode.description: What Koda may do without asking.

minAgeDays.description: Only those compacted at least this many days ago; without it, all.

StorageReadParams.description: `storage/read`: what compacted messages the store keeps.

compactedMessages.description: Messages a compaction replaced, kept until purged.

oldestCompactedAt.description: When the oldest was compacted, in Unix seconds; absent with none.

ToolCallApprovalParams.description: `item/toolCall/requestApproval`: a tool call needs a yes before it runs.

allowForSession.description:
Whether `approveForSession` may be answered: only for local changes
inside the project.

detail.description: What the call would do, in a line.

ToolCallOutputDeltaNotification.description: `item/toolCall/outputDelta`: a line of a running command's output.

delta.description: The output, ending in a newline.

oneOf.description: Waiting or running.
It ran and did what was asked.

It ran and failed: bad arguments, an error, a timeout, or a command
that exited non-zero.

It never ran: refused at an approval, by plan mode or by a
sub-agent's limits.
The turn stopped before or while it ran.

ToolEffect.description: What a tool call does, and so whether it needs a yes.

oneOf.description: Reads only.
Acts on a remote service.
Changes local files or state.
Irreversible or far-reaching: `rm -rf`, `git push --force`.

TrustMode.description: What Koda may do without asking.

oneOf.description: Read only; anything else is refused.
Anything with a side effect needs approval.
Everything runs without asking, inside the sandbox.

Turn.description: A turn. `turn/started` sends it in progress, `turn/completed` finished.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock time, set when the turn is over.

error.description:
Why it failed, when it did; and on an interrupted turn, why it
didn't stop cleanly, when it was dropped where it stood.

usage.description:
What it used: tokens and model calls, sub-agents and compaction
included. Set when the turn is over.

TurnCompletedNotification.description:
`turn/completed`: the turn is over, however it ended. Exactly one per
turn.

turnId.description: The turn to stop. Refused when it isn't the one running.

TurnInterruptResponse.description: The answer to `turn/interrupt`, sent once the turn has stopped.

TurnLoopGuardNotification.description:
`turn/loopGuard`: the model kept repeating itself. Koda's own; Codex has
none.

TurnPlanUpdatedNotification.description: `turn/plan/updated`: the model rewrote its plan (its todo list).

clientMessageId.description: The client's id for the message, echoed on its `userMessage` item.

mode.description:
The trust mode from this turn on. Without one, the session keeps
its own.

oneOf.description: Running.
The model finished.
The user or client stopped it.
It failed, after any retries.

clientMessageId.description:
The client's id for the text, echoed on the `userMessage` item that
delivers it.

expectedTurnId.description: The turn the text is for. Refused when it isn't the one running.

TurnSteerResponse.description: The answer to `turn/steer`: the text is queued for the turn.

turnId.description: The turn it was queued for.

cacheCreationTokens.description: Input tokens written to the provider's cache.

cachedInputTokens.description: Input tokens read from the provider's cache.

UserInputParams.description: `item/tool/requestUserInput`: the model asked the user a question.

options.description: Answer choices; empty for a free answer.

sessionId.description: The session, when it concerns one.

oneOf.description: Saved.
